messages.text: Can you look at this cabin panel photo? The new piece is drying duller than the old one.
You still have that small puller? Marina guy has a frozen pulley and mine walked off.
Bring the panel by Sunday. I want to see it in daylight before you sand it again.
In the garage by the primer cans. Careful moving the box with the '68 trim clips.
Should I grab the 320 paper or is that too fine?
Got it. Also saw the guitar book on your bench. Same one you were picking from last weekend?
Bring 220 and 320. We'll test a small corner first and check the sheen against the old hatch.
Yeah, the stripped-down Riders one. Easier on my fingers than the full record.
I wrote down Saturday at Sarah's. If you are going from your place, leave enough time for the 405 into Long Beach.
I can bring the folding chairs and maybe stop for ice.
Good. Daniel said he might come straight from the docks if he gets out of San Pedro before dark.
Also send me Mark's latest number again. I am updating the list before anyone needs it.
Did you call the Torrance office today, or did the job run over again?
I found Mom's gray photo box. Do you want the shots from the Redondo apartment stairs or should I keep them with the school papers?
I found Dad's old Torrance shop apron and the photo from the Hawthorne garage. Do you want them before I donate the rest?
Keep the Redondo ones for now. Sarah may want Mateo to see how bad my hair was at 16.
Ran over. They had a 2:40 slot, but that would have wiped out half the day. I asked them to keep me on the list for after 4:30.
Keep the apron. That garage paid rent more than once.
There are also two cards from Aunt Jo in Oklahoma. Same folder as the Torrance hospital envelope.
Please also ask what they want at the desk before you sit down. No surprise number after you are already there.
I also have Grandma Bowden's church cookbook from 1978. Same handwriting on every casserole card.
Set those aside. The Oklahoma names always get mixed up when Daniel asks.
Save that too. Sarah might get a kick out of those old family names.
I will. Same reason I did not book the shoulder place yet. Need the check from Hill Street to land first.
Mark said the Corona duplex is still open. He wanted me to remind you it is about 700 less than what you pay now.
I found that 1984 kitchen picture. You are in the striped shirt, Mark is holding the cereal box, and Mom still has her white counter apron on.
Keep it aside. Dad's key ring is probably on his belt in that one too.
I looked. Too far from Sarah, my regular jobs, and the morning air I need before ladders.
I found that old folder from Mom's hall closet. It has your eighth certificate and one fall report card after it.
Hold onto it for me. The adult office said any old paper helps them place me.
It is. Also the coupon pile is on the table, same as always.
I will. Also saw Ray Martinez's card tucked in there with paint notes on the back.
Fair. Are you still blocking off the 20th through 23rd for that northbound run?
Yes. Tent site first night, then a plain room if the shoulder is barking.
Figures. He wrote everything down, especially the steps before a brush ever touched the wall.
That table held up better than it should have, considering how many times he patched the legs.
Still up for Thursday? I can meet near Hermosa if your job doesn't run late.
Invoice is still sitting, so let's skip the Pier Ave place. I can do fish tacos here if you don't mind patio chairs.
Patio chairs are fine. Want me to bring limes or something easy?
Limes would help. I have tortillas, cabbage, and a little corn left from Sunday.
Are we still doing tacos Friday, or did another late job steal you?
Friday works. I just need to change first. My shirt has half a ceiling on it and the boots are staying in the truck.
Fair. I will take dinner with the cleaned-up version.
You around after the Hawthorne job? Calderon still hasn't paid and I need to talk before I get home wound up.
Call me when you hit Artesia. Don't text a novel while driving.
Good. I already deleted the thing I started typing on the neighborhood page.
Better. Ten minutes on the phone, then invoice him clean tomorrow.
Mateo left his blue sweatshirt in your cab Sunday. Can you check before he says it vanished forever?
It's there behind the seat. Cab is locked and the side boxes are latched, so it can stay till Saturday.
Good. I still remember you spending half a morning at that front desk over the missing saw kit.
They gave me a number and that was about it. Lesson learned on leaving anything loose.
Dad, someone at the marina sent that long Facebook thing about the new shots. You seen it?
No need to send it. I am checking Dr. Chen's portal note and the county page before I schedule anything.
Good. The thread under it is already a mess.
I closed it. I have better things to do than watch strangers yell.
St. Margaret's called about the hall on Del Amo. They still need someone who knows rollers, not just teenagers with trays.
I can stop by Saturday morning and look at the walls. If it's just scuffs and trim, two coats should do it.
Did you finish the ceiling job, or are you still climbing up and down tomorrow?
Maria asked if you are on their regular list. I told her no, you just help when the walls get bad.
Finished it. Right arm is staying below shoulder height tonight. Knees got too much ladder time.
That's right. Have her leave the side gate code and I will bring drop cloths.
Put the cold pack on before you fall asleep on the couch. And do the stretches the sheet showed you.
Already did the floor ones. Skipping the little square from the drawer unless I am still awake late.
Are you too beat for tacos Friday, or should I try for next week?
Friday works if I can head over straight from the North Redondo place after a rinse.
Good. Martha's at 6:45? We can keep it simple.
That sounds right. After job sites, the little rear place is best when I shut the gate and let it stay still.
Did you ever make it through those LA Convention Center booths, or did work win again?
Going Saturday morning. I saved a few booth photos from the app so I don't wander the whole place.
That pier sunset I sent you should be in that account with all the glassy wave shots.
Let me guess, ocean walls and old garage-looking prints?
Saw it. I saved the one with the clean blue water and the rail reflection. Looking at a short clip now on fixing a sticking patio slider.
Close. Also grabbed a couple finish shots for a cabinet job. One had a worn blue-gray glaze I want to try.
Dinner after the slider school, or are you doing the permit cards again tonight?
Tacos Friday works. Tonight is two sample-question clips and then that old acoustic song you mentioned.
Coffee before Hawthorne? Luis said bring the tall ladder and Marvin needs more 20-min mud.
Yeah. I told him escalera grande so nobody plays charades at 6am.
Radio was already blaming every slow job on "those crews". Turned it off before the first sip.
Coffee before Redondo job? I have to swing by the paint store anyway.
Good. Luis cuts cleaner lines than half the loudmouths talking. See you at Norm's.
Coffee place gave me ten percent off with that old card from my dad. You ever get one of those?
Yeah. Been up since 3 adding numbers on that Shoreline invoice and the license renewal fee.
Nope. I just paid full price and kept moving. Still cheaper than job-site coffee.
Figures. Bring cash tomorrow, their tap machine was acting up.
Bring the folder. We can make the invoice firmer before ladders make us feel 90.
Good. Also remind me to put the guitar case back in the living room. If it stays in the closet too long I start ducking calls.
I got the couch claimed before 7. Bring chips if you're coming by after the stucco patch.
I'll make it. Need to rinse off first. First pitch at 7:10, right?
Yeah. Don't show up in the 3rd and ask what happened.
Fair. I'll grab the salsa too.
Mateo's school moved Friday pickup to 2:15. If my last patient runs over, can you be the backup?
I can wait by the front office. Text me by 1:30 so I don't leave the job half-painted for nothing.
Thanks. Linda said she can do snack after, but she can't get there before the bell.
Fine. If Daniel comes up for the game later, I'll have him bring the booster seat back.
Dad, the county envelope came to my place too. Mateo thought the sticker was for him.
Mine is on the kitchen table. I will look at the city races after dinner and send it back before it gets buried under invoices.
Check the hospital funding one. The dental girls were talking about it today.
That one and the rent board seats are the only ones I have marked so far. The glossy mailers all sound better than the follow-through.
Can I borrow the deep socket tomorrow? Marina pump bracket is fighting me.
Yeah. Swing by after 9. I am staying in tonight anyway, sheet says I am already at $3,480 if I count gas and the paint store.
That sounds like my week. I still owe the yard for parts.
I moved $400 to the card and left the truck alone. That one is still just under $8,000, so no extra hero payment this week.
Tacos tonight or are you still married to that thick state booklet?
Tonight is booklet night. I penciled in Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday for an hour so I don't drift.
Fine, but I want proof you ate dinner and didn't just stare at practice questions.
Deal. I need the questions done before I can justify going out.
Coffee or are we pretending that wet stucco wall is happening today?
Coffee. I already moved the $400 tire money aside, so I'm not chasing that wall in the rain.
Coffee before Hawthorne? Mike says his crew starts masking at 7.
Yeah. I need him to cut the first check before I grab the extra primer. Last month looked big on paper, then Sherwin ate it.
Good. I may have two garage doors Saturday if you want brush time instead.
Get it in writing. Same as your little bathroom jobs, just with more ladders.
Text me the address after breakfast. Better than putting anything on the card.
That is what I am doing. No more buying half the wall before anybody pays a dime.
Still up for tacos tonight, or did the wall win?
Need another hour. Client wants it done before their tenant comes back, and I don't want to leave a wavy corner.
Fair. Hermosa place can wait. You always notice the one corner nobody else sees.
If my name is on the bill, they get the clean corner. Maybe 7:45 if my knees cooperate.
Coffee at Catalina before the Torrance patch job?
Give me 20. I’m doing the sand-to-pier stretch first so I don’t climb ladders all knotted up.
Good. Last week you showed up looking like that invoice was still chewing on you.
It was. The water was flat this morning though. Helped me not bring it to the job.
Bring the small socket set if you still want to look at that Chevelle after coffee.
Coffee still on? I want to hear what they said about the new coating limits.
Yeah. If it keeps headaches down in hallways, fine. I just don't want another permit desk maze for a two-day repaint.
Already by the door with my boots. I had to move the paint fan off it so I wouldn't forget.
Your place is half supply house. Don't let that Camaro print get overspray on it.
Same. Also Ray's nephew got into that paid shop class through the Local 1036 hall. Kid already knows masking better than half the new hires.
That's the part I like. Teach them right, pay them straight, less fixing bad work later.
It's above the couch, safe. I might grab that tab song later if we finish before dark.
You still want my little camp stove? I found it in the locker by the marina.
Yeah, hang on to it. Saves me buying one before I head south again.
Cool. It needs the cheap green can, not the tall one.
Perfect. Trying to keep that run gas-and-tacos only.
You still have that black ankle brace in your truck?
Yeah. Used it Thursday after those guys kept pushing the pace.
Figures. Main gym floor is nicer than the park anyway.
True. I only lasted a couple runs, then sat out and watched.
Did the March sheet open on your phone, or is it still giving you that tiny gray box?
It opened. I put the gas and tape slips in the blue envelope and took pictures of the bigger paint ones.
Good. Send me one clear photo if a row looks wrong. I can fix it after Mateo goes to bed.
I wrote Tuesday and Redondo in the margin so I know which job it was.
Did you see the Long Beach piece I sent? Mateo's teacher was talking about the camera footage rule at pickup.
I read it. I like the part where the tape gets reviewed faster and families get answers.
The comments under it are already a mess.
I'm leaving that alone. We can talk Sunday when I come by, easier than typing at strangers.
You still want that old crate from the marina? It fits rods better than paint stuff.
Yeah, bring it Sunday if it is not cracked. Mine keeps tipping in the truck.
I saw a cheap spool of 12 lb line here too. Want me to grab it?
Grab one. I used the last good stretch after Redondo last weekend.
Sarah said you sounded short earlier. Did you eat dinner or are you still stewing over that client?
Ate. I talked to Pete from the truck for a bit, so I'm not dragging it into the house.
Good. Keep it between people who know the job, not the comment section.
Yeah. I'll call you tomorrow about Dad's papers, not tonight.
When you come by Saturday, can you bring the taller ladder? The hallway bulb is the one I cannot reach.
I can. It is already strapped in. I will throw two cloths in so I do not track anything on your carpet.
I left the adult-ed office number on your counter when I dropped off the birthday plates.
Thanks. I'm not signing up this month. Using the workbook first and checking the test dates.
Thank you. Please leave the dusty shoes outside like last time.
Will do. I keep the old pair by the tailgate anyway.
That is fine, just put the dates where you will see them. Also keep the money envelope away from paint receipts.
The bathroom wall by my towel bar is bubbling again. I can wait until after your Catalina job.
Are you still coming Sunday to look at my back gate before Sarah and Mateo come by?
Already moved it to the drawer with the birth certificates and old tax stuff.
I'll stop by Saturday. Don't peel it. I need to cut out the soft spot, seal it, then skim it flat.
Yes. I'll bring the drill and that old hinge kit. No sense paying a handyman for two screws and ten minutes.
Please don't climb anything after the week you just had.
Do you need me to buy anything?
No, I have the primer and knives. Save a chip from the good part near the door if one lifts clean.
Ground work only. I still have two checks floating and rent due Friday, so Sunday will be cheap coffee and family.
Are you still coming Saturday before lunch? I have the bathroom shelf brackets ready.
I can do them. I want to stop by the magazine rack first for the new issue with the carb rebuild article.
Fine, but please do not leave my hallway half measured like last time.
I will bring the stud finder. Also found that old Fleetwood Mac song Mateo liked, just one guitar and voices.
Did you finish your February numbers? I can look at the totals before dinner Sunday.
Mostly. Checks added to 4,700. After paint store, helper, dump fees, and gas, I wrote 3,600 on the clean line.
Then put the set-aside in a separate envelope before you touch it.
I will. Also redoing the estimate sheet so the next one has money due before I start buying.
Still thinking tacos Friday, or did the ladder win again?
Friday is okay if we keep it simple. I am trying to end March closer to $3,600 than that ugly $3,800 from February.
Simple works. I know a place in Hermosa that will not punish your spreadsheet.
Good. I still have rent and the home stuff covered, but I do not want to pull the cushion below six again.
Still good for tacos Friday, or are you buried in another stack of mailers?
Tacos works. The big November ones I never skip, but these spring cards pile up and I forget until the envelope stares at me.
Read the small print on the housing one. The headline sounds nicer than the fine print.
Exactly. I like the idea, I just do not trust how much gets lost once three offices start handling it.
Bring the spare impact? Gate crew wants us in by 6:30.
Yeah. I'm parking by the trailer again, not out by Western. Boxes locked before coffee.
Good. Last time the guy with the badge cared more about cones than the busted latch.
He wrote down my plate and told me to move ten feet. That's my kind of morning.
My 4:30 patient got moved to 5:15. Can you be on standby for Mateo today, just in case?
I can, but I am in Torrance fixing Karen's cabinet until about 3.
That should still work. If I get stuck, school lets him out at 5:40.
Text me by 4. If you get free, I will just head back after Karen's.
I asked front desk. They can split the deep cleaning into two visits, but they still want the first part at check-in.
Thanks. I have a roof trim job that week and cannot disappear at 1:00. If they get a late day or Saturday, send it over.
I will watch for one. And please do the shoulder forms online so the slot does not go to someone else.
I will tonight. Trying not to add two bills in the same week if the Harbor client keeps dragging.
Mateo saw the wall picture you liked with the big curling wave. He said it looks like the skate park tunnel.
That one came from a painter's page I follow. The color fade is what got me.
The sunset pier one was nicer. Less loud.
I put that in the folder with the beach road shots. Good light for later, if I ever get out before dinner.
I can swing by after the yard if you're still watching tonight.
Yeah, Karen said Sarah might bring Mateo for the first few innings.
Cool. I have that little socket set for you too.
Bring it. I'll put out folding chairs before 6:30.
You still have that little red sanding block? I need to smooth a hatch cover before primer.
Sending you the marina sunset. Color on the hull looked like that sample strip you had on your shelf.
In the garage by the tape rolls. Don't skip the edges. Ray would make you redo it.
That orange would work better than the first one. I took a couple shots from the job today too, same kind of light.
Got it. Sarah said you're doing paperwork at night too, so I won't keep you.
Also, can you look at my carb link Sunday? I can bring the part by.
Yeah. Looking at those old report cards makes me wish I had stayed with it instead of chasing day pay.
Yeah. I will clear the little table, water the pots first, then we can mess with it.
Are you still coming by Sunday morning to look at the hall patch?
Yes. It is on the phone for 10:00, and I circled it in the book too.
Bring whatever you need for the paint. The hallway is that old soft green.
I will point the phone at it before I buy anything. I still have your last receipt photo if I need the store.
Did the Hawthorne office ever call you back? I found the card in my kitchen drawer.
They did. I have not said yes yet. Ten years ago I would have thrown the card away, so this is progress.
Progress is enough for one Friday. Also, Sarah said you did not answer twice this week.
I saw them. Bad habit from the Linda years. I am keeping the phone on and skipping the drive-thru tonight.
Are you free for tacos tomorrow or are you back on ladder duty for another hall?
Tomorrow night works. Morning is just patching corners at the Harbor center.
You always know those old buildings. Did you grow up around that one too?
Not that one. Same kind of basement smell though. Old folding chairs and coffee urns.
Still up for tacos tonight, or did the weather steal another wall from you?
Rain won. I can do a cheap plate, but I'm keeping the $400 drawer untouched after that truck noise.
Cheap plate is fine. You can be fancy when everyone wants their place brightened up again.
That starts once the sun sticks around. Tonight, two tacos and no card.
If we do dinner Saturday, do you still know that little place near the Redondo pier or is that just an old story?
I can still find it. I was cutting through those streets before I knew how to parallel park.
Then you pick. I only know the Hermosa spots and the easy parking.
Works. Nothing fancy. I have to find those Baja photos for Sarah after work anyway.
Coffee then Hawthorne job? Or you got Marcy tonight and need to look less like drywall dust?
Coffee or straight to the duplex? Guys at the shop are still yelling about that harbor march.
Coffee first. Marcy moved dinner to Thursday, so tonight is leftover soup at the rear place.
Coffee. I didn't go down there. Heard enough from Luis and the radio while sanding doors.
Same. Some people act like one bad badge means the whole station is trash.
That's not where I'm at. But when someone crosses the line, there has to be a real record and real follow-up.
Good. Lock that side gate. Alley was busy last week.
Already do. Nice when nobody tracks through after I mop, though Sundays run long in there.
The school board flyer has a question box. Do you want me to send yours in before 2?
Ask why the campus repaint bid says cheapest material only. Kids shouldn't smell that all week, and the crew shouldn't either.
Got it. Anything else?
Add whether their career center has real paid slots with contractors, not just a poster and a signup sheet.
Mateo wants to know if Grandpa can do the path with us Sunday before tacos.
Yes. I’ll meet you by Junipero at 9. I need the steps anyway after two days of drive-thru lunches.
Bring the gray hoodie. It was windy by the water today.
That’s the point. Mateo can race me to the lifeguard tower and I’ll pretend I let him win.
Mateo needs one old family photo for school. Do you have anything from when you were around his uncle Daniel's age plus ten?
I have one from when I was 16. Karen and Mark are in it, Mom had just come home smelling like sliced ham, and Dad was still in dusty boots.
That works. Mateo will ask about the boots, so send me the short version.
Tell him Grandpa fixed leaks, doors, drywall, whatever broke. Nothing fancy, just steady.
Saw your notebook in the truck. You really wrote gas, ice, campsite, and two backup motels in pencil.
That way I can leave after Friday work and still change it if rain hits north of Morro Bay.
Mom said someone sent you a Temecula room ad again.
Let them have it. I can fix a boat rail in San Pedro and be back by dinner from here.
Still coming by to look at that pump bracket before the game?
Yeah, but no crawling under the trailer for me. Low back is not signing up after two ceilings this week.
I can put it on the stand. Bring the socket set?
Bringing it. Took two Advil and packed the blue ice sleeve, so I am keeping it simple.
Sarah put Mateo's school picture where Aunt Rosie can see it. Please hit the heart so she stops asking me if you saw it.
Done. I also saw Mark's note about the alley paving meeting and the old Ford parts post Pete tagged me in.
Good. Are you still coming by after your morning errands?
Yes. Finishing a seven-minute faucet cartridge clip first so I bring the right puller.
Parking is half empty by the pier. Wind looks decent so far.
Same coffee spot before the Redondo patch job?
Yeah. Been meeting crews at that counter since my old man dragged me there.
Good. I checked the report at 5 and it said shoulder-high sets till about 8.
Your dad knew every busted stucco wall from Gardena to Hermosa.
Old guys are by the lifeguard stand already. Coffee after?
After one round, then I need to rinse gear and water the succulents.
He'd still say we underbid this one.
Sending the hospital page I mentioned. It has the same timing chart the county posted.
Thanks. I would rather read that than the screenshot Karen's neighbor put up.
Yeah, don't bother with the replies under that one.
Already stayed out of it. I will ask the pharmacy when I pick up my refill Monday.
Mateo found your extra shirt in my back seat. The gray one from the center.
Leave it by the door if you can. I might swing by before the 6:30 group.
Okay. Do you need the water bottle too?
Yes, thanks. Last time I forgot and paid for it halfway through.
For Sarah's 31st on Saturday, are you bringing tacos or the cake?
I'll bring tacos. Daniel said he can make it after the marina shift.
Good. Mateo is six and still picks frosting over dinner, so maybe cupcakes are safer.
Tell Linda the same start time if she asks. I don't want three versions of the plan floating around.
You skipped the fancy place again. I should have guessed.
Tacos were better and I put the difference in the blue envelope.
The one with the beach town in France written on it?
Hossegor, if the envelope ever gets heavy enough.
Coffee before the Hawthorne patch job or straight there?
Straight there. I grabbed a bag of trail mix at Chevron and don't need to burn another ten before 7.
Fair. Bring that leftover corn if you have it. My lunch is sad.
I've got corn and zucchini from the grill. No ribs left, Mateo cleaned those out.
Mateo asked why you said the TV guy was being lazy at dinner.
Because he pointed at people he never met and made it sound simple. I spend all day next to guys like Luis and Marvin.
That makes sense. He mostly remembered you saying "cuidado" when he ran near your toolbox.
Better word for him to remember than whatever that TV desk was selling.
For Mateo's school family tree thing, did Grandpa ever have a photo in a dress uniform or was that only Uncle Ray?
That was Ray. For me just Little League, shop class, paint crews, and bad haircuts.
Got it. I will use the one by your old truck then.
You disappeared after dinner. Long day?
Long and dumb. I stepped outside and called Pete before I said something sharp.
I noticed you never put those rants where everyone can pile on.
Nothing good comes from that. Easier to talk to one person and be done.
Do you still have those stackable bins in the back of your truck? I need to sort the marina hardware before it all rolls around.
Yeah. Mine are labeled by tape, filters, blades, and rags. Makes mornings less stupid.
Send me a picture later. I am tired of digging under ropes for a 3/8 bit.
I will after I unload the small scaffold pieces.
Sunday still good for the game? I can get out of San Pedro by 11 if the pump job is done.
Works. Haven't seen you since last month, so I will keep it open.
Karen texted me twice about Mark's cake. Is she putting you on dessert duty?
Probably. She has the whole thing mapped out before Riverside even answers.
Marina pump cover is stuck. You got that strap wrench still?
In the blue box. Don't force it. Tap around the rim first and keep the gasket clean.
Can I grab it Saturday morning?
Come by early. I have to price the Belmont job after, then maybe walk the pier before the phone starts ringing.
Dinner Friday still works, or are you trapped with that beach house?
Friday works if the owner signs off. She picked satin, then hated how the hallway flashed under the skylight.
You noticed that from the doorway, didn't you?
Old habit. I left two samples on separate boards so she can look morning and late afternoon.
Coffee before Hawthorne? I got the drywall knives.
Yep. Bringing the no-smell primer sample too. Client asked why it costs more.
Tell them breathing easy costs extra. You still reading that CSLB thing after dinner?
Thursday hour, then invoice cleanup. Trying to make the next year look less hand-to-mouth.
That old Malibu poster you sent, was that from the show or online?
Show had the vendor, but I found the cleaner shot later on IG. Same cream border, better scan.
Send me the link. The boat shop wall is empty by the parts counter.
I'll send it. There's another account with marina fog photos you might like too.
Do you still have that deep socket set or did it disappear with the other stuff?
Deep sockets survived. The grinder and laser never showed back up.
Need a copy of anything for the marina gate pass? They ask about tickets and weird old paperwork.
Just put my license info. Nothing bigger than moving slips and that shop lot number from last year.
I put my city packet in the Torrance box this morning. Did you handle yours, or is it still sitting by the coffee maker?
Handled last week. I learned after missing that spring one two years ago and hearing about it from you.
Good. I know you were looking at wages for the port contractors and that apartment inspection item.
Those mattered. Still, every office promises clean handling before the money starts wandering.
Did the dentist office give you a number for the first visit?
Not yet. If it's around $400 I can handle it, but March has had too many blank mornings.
Blank because of the rain?
Mostly outside prep. Pete says April calls are already coming in, so I may take a Saturday or two first.
Mark is forwarding another long thread. Please do not get dragged into it tonight.
I'm not answering. I watched the Channel 7 segment and I'll talk to him at dinner if he wants.
Good. What did they say about the new 911 team?
Two clinicians on weekend calls, more training hours, and reports going to the review board every month.
Dinner Sunday, or are you buried in that workbook again?
Sunday works if I finish two sections. I keep hitting stuff I should have handled when I was a kid.
Fair. And don't show up with primer on your hands this time.
No promises. Ray's voice still gets in my head: sand flat, tape straight, then open the can.
You still taking the ladder setup on Strand today?
Yeah, but I am keeping it short. Shoulder barked all night and I cannot afford to lose the van if I slip.
Good. Also get half up front from Strand. Paint store is not a charity.
Already texted him. Last week was 51 hours and still felt tight after the tire patch.
You still have Grandpa's old taping knife? Marina wall patch is ugly.
In the blue box. Same one he kept by the back door when Karen and Mark and I were all packed around that little hallway.
I'll grab it after work. Mom said you also found a receipt from Grandma's market.
Yeah, tucked under the coupons. Checker number stamped on it, looks like her handwriting on the back.
You watching Dodgers tomorrow or buried in license stuff?
License book is open, but I need a break. Client still has not paid, so my brain keeps doing math.
Come by after the marina. I restrung that old acoustic you gave me.
That helps. If I go another week without touching strings and live on chips, Karen will start making lists.
I saw Aunt Rita stirring people up under that city hall post. Please tell me you are not in there.
No. I looked up the county page and left it alone.
Good. Sarah said she sent you the cleaner link anyway.
She did. If Dr. Chen's office says the same thing Monday, that is enough for me.
I drove past that old bowling alley you mentioned near Lomita. Was that really your Friday night place?
Hermosa has those little jewelry and print booths tomorrow. Still pretending you only go for tacos?
When we had gas money. Otherwise it was burgers by the pier and back home before Mom noticed.
Tacos are a fair reason. I also need drawer pulls and maybe that guy with old door handles is back.
That sounds very you. Nothing fancy, just local.
And if the record tent has another dusty Rumours copy, I will act surprised.
Pretty much. Same streets, different paint on the buildings.
Only if it is the one with the quieter side cuts. No scratched-up beach sand special.
Did you make it past Santa Barbara or did the Friday traffic win?
Made it. Took the slow lane, stopped for groceries, and grabbed the 72 dollar room instead of setting up in the dark.
Very you. Dinner when you are back, unless the desert house emails finally tempt you.
Nope. I like being ten minutes from work coffee and an evening walk by the pier.
Coffee first or straight to that rec room job?
Coffee. I told Luis I would be there at 8 with the extension pole.
Luis buying paint this time or are you donating half your garage again?
Coffee first or straight to Lomita? Client says cabinet doors are dragging.
Coffee. I watched a guy shim the hinge plates without chewing up the paint. Sending it when I park.
They bought the eggshell. I am only bringing brushes and the old kneeler pad for my knees.
Send the one with the pearl white clearcoat too. That finish looked close to the Chevy group photo.
Got it saved with the blues riff lesson. Same folder as the C-36 brake-light questions.
Mateo's class is doing family map week. Can you send me one old photo that is not just a Dodgers cap?
I have the Redondo apartment stairs and the Torrance baby envelope Karen found. Which one is less embarrassing?
Send both. Also anything with the Oklahoma side, because he keeps asking who Aunt Jo is.
I'll text them after coffee. The Mexico beach ones are in the same envelope if you want those too.
Mateo wants to bring you the school drawing. Is Saturday after soccer okay?
Saturday is better than Sunday evening. The place gets too still after dinner on Sundays.
We can do Saturday. Do you still only have the two stools by the little table?
Two stools and the folding chair from Pete if you both come in. Easier to eat tacos outside if the weather holds.
Do you know if "cubeta" is bucket? New guy at the marina kept saying it while we were rinsing parts.
Yep. Cubeta bucket, cinta tape, cuidado watch it. I learned those the useful way.
Some customer was muttering about the yard guys taking over. Weird.
Best answer is usually a clean repair and letting him stand there quiet.
Found that photo Mom wanted scanned. You and Linda at the old hall, 1994 written on the back.
Keep it flat. I was 28 there and that print is already curling.
Sarah wants copies too. Mateo laughed at your mustache.
Everybody's a critic. Bring it when you come by after work.
Dinner still okay at 6, or are you stuck washing sand out of the truck again?
Still okay. I just need ten minutes to hang the wetsuit and put the bait bucket outside.
Bring one of those pier sunset pictures if you have a good one. The last one was actually pretty.
Mateo wants beach path later, but only if your arm is okay after yesterday.
Walk is fine. No carrying him on my shoulders. The roller over the stairwell got me.
Please do the band moves first. And eat before you take anything from the orange bottle.
Will do. Also not touching that sleepy square before seeing Mateo. Last time I felt cloudy till lunch.
Mateo asked if dinner at your place means the little tortillas again.
Tell him yes, but I'm using the fish in the freezer and the vegetables from my bin. No takeout bag this time.
That works. I can bring fruit after work.
Good. If I'm late from Torrance I'll eat the crackers in the truck and start the pan when I get home.
Mateo asked if Grandpa still has the foam finger from last time.
Somewhere in the garage. Tell him he can use it if he doesn't hit the lamp again.
We'll come after dinner if the late tip isn't too much for him.
If he fades, no problem. I'll save him the first bowl of popcorn.
Harbor office asked if you had any old separation papers for the vendor priority form.
No papers like that for me. Send them my contractor license info and the South Bay references.
Okay. I will attach Pete and Martinez Paint as references.
That will cover what they need.
Found a box of your old stuff in my garage. Redondo High sticker, beach photo, and some card postmarked Tulsa.
That sticker survived longer than the car. The Tulsa card is probably Aunt Jo or one of her boys.
There are also Rosarito pictures. You want me to drop all of it at Karen's?
Yes. Keep the boat part receipts separate so I don't lose your stuff in my old mess.
You free Sunday before the game? I need to borrow the ladder.
Let me check the phone and the little book. I may have a touch-up in San Pedro.
Marina is taking two helpers from the Harbor adult program. One starts Monday.
Good. Better than throwing a kid a broom and calling it experience.
No rush. Also Sarah said you finally got that March file going.
Mostly. I still toss the small slips in envelopes first, then add pictures when I sit down.
They said the old shops had dues cards and better raises. You ever carry one?
No card for me. But when a place teaches the trade and keeps the pay from sliding backward, I won't knock it.
You still going to the game Sunday or buried in bids?
Game is fine. I sent two small rooms tonight and Mike's condo touch-up tomorrow.
Nice. You making them put something down first this time?
Yes. After February's 4,700 turned into 3,600 before the tax envelope, I am not floating paint for strangers.
For Sunday, are you bringing something or should I add another tray?
Did you mail the birthday card for Mateo? Also, please tell me you looked at your end-of-month bills before buying more paint.
I'll bring ribs if I find a decent pack, plus corn. I still have rosemary and that lavender from your yard.
Card is on the passenger seat. Bills are lined up: rent already cleared at $2,050, then Edison, gas, internet, groceries, truck fuel.
Good. You get quiet when the numbers stack up.
Use what you have. No need to make an extra stop.
I am fine. March should land around $3,520 if nothing weird hits, cushion just under $6,000, card lower after that $400, truck still around eight.
That's the idea. The marina check hasn't landed, so I'm staying out of restaurants this week.
Still up for tacos tomorrow, or did the ladder win again?
Tacos still good. I just got home, set the boots down, and the thing by the couch is staring at me.
The one with strings? Play something before you start scrolling paint colors.
Maybe after I check the grill tank. I saved one easy video for later.
Still up for dinner tomorrow, or are you married to the tide chart again?
Dinner yes. I’m just trying to get one clean hour in the morning before the ladder work.
So 6 a.m. water, 7 a.m. responsible adult, 6 p.m. tacos?
That order usually keeps me decent company. Pick the taco place, just not the one with the giant fried plate.
Still up for tacos tomorrow or did that Venice job steal you again?
Still up. Long day, though. Ramon was calling measurements from the scaffold and I only caught half the numbers before the compressor kicked on.
The photo you showed me at dinner was sweet. Was that your sister on one side and your brother on the other?
Yeah, Karen and Mark. That was our old place, probably right after Mom's late shift and before Dad got called back out for a busted door.
You and your work stories. Was this the crew you said got blamed by the client before they even opened the paint cans?
Same one. By lunch they had the cleanest hallway in the building. People should watch the work first.
No wonder you looked tired in it.
We all did. Still had dinner on the table, though, even if it was stretched pretty thin.
Coffee first or straight to the Lomita place?
Coffee at Norm's or straight to the condo?
Coffee. I need five minutes to swap the filters and tighten that ladder clamp.
Norm's. Need you to look at my estimate before I send it. Materials jumped again and I don't want to eat it.
Bring extra cloths. That owner was twitchy about the floors.
Coffee before the Hermosa patch job? I got there early.
Coffee at 6:20? Bring that wide tape. Client's trim is all wavy.
Bring that phone pic of the green cabinet glaze. Client picked the flat white again unless we scare him straight.
Add the prep hours. Don't donate your back for beach-house trim.
Five minutes out. Bring the paper you were griping about, the one with the contractor wage rule.
Packed already. Boots are by the passenger door so I do not forget them.
I'll bring it. Ray used to say bad tape makes you paint the same room twice.
Got three saved. One from a shop wall, one from a painter in Venice, one from that Hido-looking booth shot.
Same promises, different faces. They all find a way to spend twice as much.
He wasn't wrong. You still going to that evening thing after work?
Already wrote them in. If they want it square and dry by Monday, the number has to match the ladder time.
Hido-looking means dark and blurry, right?
Coffee or straight to the Torrance patch job?
Dark road, bright edge. Same reason the pier photos work. See you at coffee.
Maybe. But the wage rule, clinic money, and cleaner port equipment are closer to what I want than the tax-cut flyers.
Coffee. Been up since 4 thinking about the van payment.
Blue Butterfly in ten. Bring the numbers, leave the Facebook crowd out of it.
Yeah. They put me with the basic book first, which is humbling, but I need to finish what I didn't.
On my way. If it still looks ugly after coffee, I'll ring Karen at lunch.
You moving slow this morning or just old?
Both. Went to the center last night and chased guys half my age.
Smart before ladders.
I know. Coffee first, then I'll stretch before we start.
Mateo wants to help you with the little step stool tomorrow. I told him no ladders.
Good. He can hand me blue tape and count outlet covers. Nothing above the second step.
He asked why you keep so many brushes in coffee cans.
Mateo's class has that heritage poster due Monday. He asked if Bowden came from your dad's side or Grandma's.
Tell him some are older than his mom. The good angled ones still make cleaner corners than new cheap ones.
Dad's side. Tell him the family stories are mostly Torrance, Hawthorne, and paint trucks.
That's probably exactly what he'll draw. Maybe a ladder and your old Dodgers cap.
As long as the ladder is safer than mine.
Mateo asked if you saw the soccer pictures. I put them with the family album from last weekend.
Saw them after the neighborhood traffic post. He looks fast in the blue cleats.
He is proud. Also, don't forget your studying before dinner with Marcy.
Doing one lane-change quiz clip now, then a song run-through. I saved a Hermosa surf shot to show her too.
I found the daycare emergency form. It still has you, Linda, and Daniel listed for Mateo.
Leave me on there. Daniel works San Pedro days, so I'm more useful if your office gets stuck.
Also, the 2014 file you asked about is in my hall closet with the old tax folder.
Thanks. Twelve years and that folder still turns up when we least need it.
Mateo says you promised to show him the shiny piece from the old car. Is that safe for six-year-old hands?
It is just the cleaned-up hood letter, no sharp edges. I will keep the solvent stuff away.
Good. He also keeps humming the song from your kitchen, the one with the long rain keyboard part.
I had the low-volume version on while sanding. I will switch to something shorter before he asks for it ten times.
Still up for tacos Tuesday, or did the house in Manhattan Beach wreck you?
Tuesday works. Today was all trim over my head, so I am doing ice and the wall slides before bed.

Still have three of the four left. Not worth the morning haze unless I really cannot settle down.

If it clears, two nights. Same cheap spot below Ensenada.

Good. I already set aside $40 for gas and ice.
